title: Middleware Software Engineering Intern
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Middleware Software Engineering Graduate Intern, you will contribute to the development of middleware software components that facilitate communication, data management, and abstraction between applications and hardware. In this hands-on role, you will assist with API design, protocol implementation, and performance optimization across distributed or embedded systems. Your work will support Intel's platforms, ensuring seamless integration and scalability for end users.
Business group
The Data Center Group (DCG) focuses on advancing Intel's leadership in performance and efficiency for data center infrastructure. This group drives innovations in distributed systems software and hardware platforms, enabling cutting-edge solutions for cloud computing, machine learning, and enterprise-level applications. Joining DCG means contributing to transformative technologies that power tomorrow's digital world.
Key Responsibilities
- Collaborate with application developers, system architects, and platform teams to develop scalable middleware solutions.
- Assist with API design and protocol implementation to optimize communications between software and hardware.
- Support performance tuning and debugging efforts across distributed and embedded systems.
- Conduct research and contribute to projects that align with Intel's business goals and technological advancements.
- Gain hands-on experience in middleware development and explore future career opportunities.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Must be pursuing a degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Working knowledge of Linux and familiarity with compilers and makefiles.
- Fluency in C/C++ programming with strong debugging skills.
Preferred Qualifications
- Familiarity with CPU and GPU architectures.
- Understanding of system software, including libraries, operating systems, and runtime environments.
- Experience with parallel programming, multi-threaded runtimes, and performance evaluation.
We are excited to welcome passionate learners who are eager to explore, grow, and make an impact in the world of middleware software development. Apply today and take the first step in building your career with Intel.
